name: A member satisfying a Contract requirement must write impl

input.source_text: contract C { fun m() -> Nil } class A for C { fun m() -> Nil {} }

applicability.reason: v1.36 has no member-level impl obligation: top-level impl establishes conformance and one Method supplies both dispatch surfaces. This vector therefore preserves its stale class-for source as an explicit incompatibility diagnostic rather than silently inventing a replacement semantic.
